Jamie: Hey Alex, noticed those influencers posting all those foot pics again?

Alex: Yeah, right? It's just feet!

Jamie: Ugh, you're jealous, aren't you?

Alex: Jealous? No way! I’m just... fascinated by the human body in general.

Jamie: (skeptically) Right. Because feet are such a fascinating part of the body.

Alex: Look, Jamie, I get why you’re bothered by it, but I don’t see it as weird or creepy. People share all sorts of things online.

Jamie: (defensive) I know, but still. It’s just too much focus on something so... inconsequential.

Alex: Maybe it’s just attention-seeking? Or maybe they’re just sharing what they enjoy and what makes them feel comfortable.

Jamie: I guess you could look at it that way. But it’s still gross to me.

Alex: We can agree to disagree, but hey, everyone has different quirks, right?

Jamie: Yeah, I suppose. Thanks for understanding.
